description: East West Insurance Company Limited is a Pakistani general insurer that began operations in 1983, founded by the late Unus Khan, who was its first chairman. The company underwrites general insurance business and describes itself as having built a branch network across the country, working to a stated goal of sustained growth, secure policyholder protection, a maintained industry position and cost-effective innovation.
headOffice: 401-404, Block 'B', 4th Floor, Lakson Square Building No. 3, Sarwar Shaheed Road, Karachi, Pakistan
